B3 step 2: real squads in the battle scene (?mode=battle&a=&d=): leaders by roster name, soldiers man and woman in turn, the enemy's soldiers red in the shader, a mounted formation

B3 step 3: the battle script (src/battle/script.ts, pure): ClashSim beats to timed acts (runs, swings, shots, hurts, falls, flashes, cheers, the result); clips moved to clips.ts; tested against resolveClash over 50 seeds and all 36 class pairs

B3 step 4: the director plays the rules' battle in the scene (src/battle/Director.ts): charge, counter, duels, panic, flashes, falls, cheers; live HUD pips, Morale and callouts; Space skips; check.mjs battle checks; scripts/battlevideo.mjs; 3 battle videos

B3 step 4 review: fighters take their opposite numbers (head v head, soldier v soldier, then spread over the soldiers left, the head last); soldiers in proportion to Morale; the fallen fade back to their places (clash.ts target(), soldiersFor())

B3 step 5: stance keys A/S/D (from the next beat), the edge on each banner, the skill gauge (src/game/gauge.ts: 4 a hit, 6 a duel won, x1.5 aggressive, none passive) rising as blows land; ?at= opens a battle still; check.mjs stance and gauge checks

B3 step 6: attack from the skirmish and back (canAttack/attackWith in turn.ts: a foe on the next tile, once a turn, after moving but not before; target marks; BattleScene shared with ?mode=battle; tile defence in the battle; Morale applied on return, the camera unchanged, a unit at 0 leaves; the map stops drawing during the battle); check.mjs attack checks; 70/70 map identity

B4 step 1: cards and the turn rules (src/game/cards.ts: 12 cards, POW + 5 MOV = 115, an ACE and a named skill each; deal 8 a side by seed; the hand refills once all are played. turn.ts: no move or attack without a card, the pool is the card's MOV, a used card is refused, swap or take back until the first move, one battle a side a turn and it ends the turn). The skirmish plays the longest reach left until the hand is on screen (step 2); battles use the card's POW

B4 step 2: the hand on the map (src/ui/CardHand.ts): 8 menu-style cards (name, POW, MOV, ACE; the focused card's skill in a box above); click or arrows + Z to play, X takes it back before a move, C shows it (look only once a unit has moved); used cards greyed and stamped; the turn box shows the card; tile and unit panels step aside while it is open; check.mjs card checks; 70/70 map identity

B4 step 3: one battle a turn and the foes' turn (the battle's POW is the card's; coming back from it ends the turn; the foes' turn shows for 1.5 s in a red box with their card, taking no orders, then the next turn opens on the hand; the board's clock no longer counts the time spent in a battle); check.mjs flow checks; a video of one full turn; 70/70 map identity

Card art round step 1: the spending guard (scripts/art/spend.mjs: price each call, refuse past ARK_CAP_USD, ledger in art/source/spend.json) in generate.mjs, and scripts/art/video.mjs for Seedance 2.0 clips

Card art round step 2: Long Road's layers by Seedream through the API (plate, Aria and a sword soldier from their standing images, a milestone and straw grass in front; $0.14) and scripts/art/cardart.py (key, defringe the rim light's glow, place, grade, contact shadow, depth map) -> public/cards/long-road/

Card art round step 4: the card renderer (src/cards/: layout, looks, frameArt, ArtStage, CardView, showcase) and ?mode=card&id=: the painted frame, stats and crested back; the art window as a layer stack with depth parallax, sunbeams, dust, a sword glint and the hover clip; tilt toward the pointer, float, flip, touch and gyro; foil and emboss on the metal; the foes' crimson stock; check.mjs card checks

Card art round step 3: Long Road's hover clip by Seedance 2.0 Mini, Fast and 2.0 (same still as first and last frame, prompt and seed; $1.75 in all) side by side; Mini drifts and ends off the still, Fast and 2.0 loop back; Fast's installed as public/cards/long-road/motion.mp4 until the user picks

Card art round: the other 11 cards with Seedance 2.0 Fast (the user's pick): Seedream layers from the standing images ($1.91 with retries), cardart.py unlight/warm keying and whole-width foregrounds, 11 Fast hover clips ($6.66, all loop back to their stills), clips at CRF 23 (23 MB for 12); each card's own light kind in ArtStage (12 modes), rain as streaks; check.mjs checks every card's files and the no-art fallback with the art hidden

The animated cards replace the B4 pixel hand: handLayout (pure, tested: the fan, the focused card lifted, a clickable point per card), HandView (own full-resolution canvas, CardView per card, DOM hit boxes, used/in-play states, the focused card's clip, F and long-press flip, touch-aware keys line, the foes' card turning face up; idle when closed), lazily loaded clips, hand cards painted and loaded at their size on screen (paint scale, scaled-down layers, one back per side), the foes' cards pre-loaded; FOES_TURN 2.6 s; check.mjs hand checks

Unions: fightUnion in the rules core (one battle per member against the same foe, losses carried, stops when the foe falls; 6 tests); the Union marked violet on the board with its shape's empty places edged, UNION xN in the unit panel; the attack plays the chain, every battle in full, labelled UNION n / N in the battle HUD; check.mjs union checks (highlight = rules, order, carried Morale, stop on a fall)

Card skills: the gauge carried on each unit (ClashSim tracks it, fired skills empty it); src/game/skills.ts (which card has which skill, canFire = full gauge + ACE, why not, All In on play); 11 battle effects in ClashSim (19 tests); the battle holds at its opening for the choice with a guide (K fire / Space save, buttons for touch); the cut-in with the card's clip; hit-stop and shake on skill blows; SKL gauge in the unit panel; Pike Wall's text sharpened; check.mjs skill checks
B6 review round 1: the cut-in slower (4.2 s from 1.9) with the card's clip in focus: the battle dims, a taller band, the clip about 40% larger, the name easing in; K, Space or Enter skips it

Enemy AI and win/lose: src/game/ai.ts (planTurn Easy/Hard, forecast over 8 seeds, the pool shared so foes advance together, steered by walking cost; 11 tests), src/game/end.ts (outcome, stats); the foes' turn plays the plan (card, walks, a Union attack the player defends in, skills fired on their own, All In for them too); ResultScreen (VICTORY/DEFEAT, stats, Play again/New map); Foes: Easy/Hard picker (?foes=hard); battle banners coloured by side; check.mjs: untilPlayerTurn, holdFoes, 7 B7 checks
